technicalValidation.motionScope: Conservative continuous yaw proof: yaw about world Z preserves all Z coordinates. For turret children use minimum vertex Z. For gun vertices over elevation0..20degrees evaluate Z=gpZ+dx*sin(theta)+dz*cos(theta) at both endpoints and every stationary angle in interval. Triangle Z extrema occur at vertices. Positive vertical interval separation rules out crossings, coplanar contact and containment with either grille for every yaw and all elevations in this interval.
limitations: Scope is this rigid hierarchy, fixed hull and0..20degree elevation without recoil translation. No proof for hull pitch/roll, gun depression, changed pivots or deformations.
Attachment is geometric contact/overlap at fixed hull rear, not engineering strength or manufacturing suitability.
Native diagnostic receipt assertions and hash-verified GLB are complementary; masks are one supplied camera projection and not all-view visibility.
Technical checks confer no visual recommendation, human approval, source completion or game-readiness.
